title: bmo-chat command
what: The bmo-chat command, whose mcp verb starts the MCP server on standard input and output for the provider at the address given, offering each request once (plugin/src/main.rs).

title: MCP server
what: The MCP server that lists the harness tools over one provider at a given address and answers each call through the provider client, its refusals as tool errors (plugin/src/server.rs).

title: OpenAPI documents
what: The generated OpenAPI 3.1 documents, one for each side, built from the client's wire types and the harness tool table; a test fails when a committed document differs from what the code generates (plugin/src/openapi.rs, docs/openapi/).

title: Harness tools
what: The nine tools the harness drives a provider through, each a thin call of one provider-client method, with the input and output schemas the MCP server and the OpenAPI document both read from this one table (plugin/src/tools.rs).
